Initial setup:
  Revaer starts in setup mode and keeps the API listener loopback-only until the
  instance is activated. Complete first-run setup with a port-forward:

  kubectl port-forward deployment/{{ include "revaer.fullname" . }} 7070:7070 8080:8080

  After setup, update the Revaer bind address so the Service can receive
  external traffic through {{ include "revaer.fullname" . }}.
